It is the centralized single sign-on service for the workforce, successor to AWS Single Sign-On. Case: which token should be sent to the API?
A developer suggests sending the refresh token in the Authorization header on every API call, "because it lasts longer".
How should you respond?
Good idea: it avoids signing in again.
The refresh token is a long-lived secret; exposing it on every call increases the risks.
You must send the token suited to the API (access token or ID token depending on the configuration); the refresh token is only used to ask Cognito for new tokens.
The refresh token is intended for Cognito to renew tokens, not for business APIs.
